programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Atlanta discovers a suitcase left in the airport by its owner, which contains cocaine concealed in coffee bags. Suspecting a trend, officers begin blitzing flights from the source country and make a second arrest. CBP Miami investigates a series of wildlife trafficking crimes, including an elderly man suspected of smuggling birds to the US in his pants; and a shipment of more than 1400 turtle shell fragments that were forcibly removed from an endangered species. HSI New York arrests a suspected cocaine smuggler who works at JFK and uncovers information that takes-down an entire drug-trafficking ring.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A small commuter plane begins a short flight when disaster strikes. Moments after takeoff, the nose of the aircraft pitches up dramatically. The flight crew struggles for control. The plane is just 350 meters in the air when it stalls, rolls to the left, and plummets to the ground. It slams into a packed hangar, killing everyone on board. Combing through the wreckage, investigators find a single clue that leads them to uncover a string of errors and faulty assumptions that have been putting millions of passengers at risk for years.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: April 4, 1977. Southern Airways flight 242 is en-route from Huntsville, Alabama to Atlanta, Georgia. Ten minutes into the flight the crew notices a menacing storm in their path. Their radar shows them a "hole" in the middle of the storm, the crew believes that "hole" is an area of better weather, and decides to fly towards it. Suddenly the plane is in the midst of a punishing rain and hailstorm. The hail is so severe that it cracks the cockpit windshield, and visibility is nonexistent. They crew has lost power to many of their instruments, and one by one theyve lost both of their engines. Theyre now trying to glide to a safe landing. The tower suggests heading towards Dobbins Air Force Base, 20 miles away. En route to Dobbins the crew realizes they arent going to make it, they decide to put the DC-9 down on a nearby highway. Almost immediately though, it clips a tree with its left wing, ploughs into a car at service station, breaks up and bursts into flames. An inferno erupts. The flight crew, 62 passengers, and 8 people on the ground are killed. Astoundingly, 21 people on board survive.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: November 27, 1987. A 747 Combi is on a routine flight toward South Africa when the cabin begins filling with smoke. Passengers struggle to breathe as crew members attempt to fight a fire in the cargo hold. After the plane disappears in the Indian Ocean, an unprecedented recovery operation is launched to locate and raise the wreckage from the ocean floor. Rumours swirl. Did illegal weapons bring down Flight 295?

programme.title: Dutch Caribbean Coastguards
programme.desc: We went on a mission with the Coast Guard of Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and Sint Maarten. Every day they carry out impressive operations, from rescuing tourists in distress to intercepting drug shipments at sea and receiving undocumented immigrants. This important and also dangerous work is done by a team of committed professionals, who guarantee safety in the Caribbean Sea with the help of ships and helicopters. They are supported by the Royal Netherlands Navy.

programme.title: Dutch Caribbean Coastguards
programme.desc: We went on a mission with the Coast Guard of Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and Sint Maarten. Every day they carry out impressive operations, from rescuing tourists in distress to intercepting drug shipments at sea and receiving undocumented immigrants. This important and also dangerous work is done by a team of committed professionals, who guarantee safety in the Caribbean Sea with the help of ships and helicopters. They are supported by the Royal Netherlands Navy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we arrive in the holy city of Jerusalem to explore what we call the "God Brain." Billions of people around the world believe in a divine being, but how does the "believing brain" work? Is spirituality hardwired or installed in us by a divine Programmer, or is it part of a complex evolutionary adaptation process that has been transpiring for millions of years? This episode is an exciting opportunity to exploit hidden-camera experiments, man-on-the-street encounters, and high-tech laboratories across the globe in the quest to explore the neuro-physiology behind spiritual practice. The games devised in this episode will shed light on our perception of morality, faith, and the supernatural.You will learn that even those who don't practice religion feel an instinctual desire to believe, a desire that Dean Hamer from the National Institute of Heath calls "the God gene." Play along as we engage in brain games that suggest you do believe even if you think you dont!

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The spring season progresses and the residents of Port Protection encounter tasks and challenges. Curly is a good neighbor by helping his friend Jiggy with a rotten tree that threatens to fall on his house and finds his experience and determination tested. Mary passes the torch of knowledge to Amanda, teaching her the finer points on how to hunt and track game to provide her with the tools to survive on her own. Sam readies the fire patrol boat, staging a fire drill with other community members, which involves setting a real fire.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Spring has arrived, and in Port Protection that means there is work to be done, despite lingering bad weather. Hans and Timbi start a greenhouse to grow fresh vegetables and herbs for the year. Sam scours an old warehouse for materials to build a portable stove. Mary travels to town to acquire supplies needed for the spring hunting season, and Curly takes Amanda out for a grueling lesson in dropping trees and collecting firewood.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Hunting Alaskan Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The Arctic Circle, Northern Alaska. Its minus 35 degrees, inhospitable, literally crawling with bears. A team of adventurous palaeontologists are heading into this icy wilderness, to make it their home for 2 weeks. Why? Because, they think they've found something truly unique, undiscovered - and ground-breaking, A lost world of Alaskan Dinosaurs.

programme.title: Lost Beasts: Unearthed
programme.desc: Lost Beasts Unearthed combines unique access to real-time palaeontology investigations, pioneering technology and explosive CGI animations to unlock the mysteries of the biggest beasts ever to have lived on our planet. From deadly T-Rex's to giant woolly mammoths and terrifying sabre-tooth tigers to ancient sea-monsters. New evidence reveals how these giants evolved to conquer the planet, how they grew so big, how they hunted, what they ate, how they fought and what triggered their extinction.

programme.title: Lost Beasts: Unearthed
programme.desc: Lost Beasts Unearthed combines unique access to real-time palaeontology investigations, pioneering technology and explosive CGI animations to unlock the mysteries of the biggest beasts ever to have lived on our planet. From deadly T-Rex's to giant woolly mammoths and terrifying sabre-tooth tigers to ancient sea-monsters. New evidence reveals how these giants evolved to conquer the planet, how they grew so big, how they hunted, what they ate, how they fought and what triggered their extinction.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Mutant Weather takes viewers onto the front line of the shocking new weather phenomena that, thanks to climate change, are changing the world around us faster than we can keep up: terrifying elemental events with names like Dry Lightning, Thundersnow, Polar Vortexes, Firenadoes, Ice Waves and Atmospheric Rivers. Mutant Weather tells the stories of these mutations, from gestation and birth to their cataclysmic impact and how they will evolve next, using spectacular video footage, first-hand testimonies from those who've experienced them, expert scientific analysis, stunning graphics and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the twin towers fell in 2001, many engineers thought the era of the skyscraper was over. But the extraordinary catastrophe marked a turning point of a different kind. Safety codes and new understandings were shared internationally, and enthusiasm for tall buildings reached new heights. Construction of supertall buildings — skyscrapers taller than 300 meters — accelerated. Now, there are 71 cities across the world with at least one. Each one, from the One World Trade Center in New York to the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, stands on the shoulders of past failures, hard lessons written in concrete and steel.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: A routine flight from London Heathrow to Belfast International Airport ended in tragedy when British Midland Flight 92 crashed onto a motorway embankment near the town of Kegworth on 8th January 1989. An engine failure meant the crew would have to make what should have been a straightforward emergency landing. Tragically, the pilots mistakenly identified and shut-off the wrong engine, leading to a catastrophic crash near the M1. In this episode, survivors give us their first-hand account of the horrific accident..

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: In 1982, British Airways Flight 9 suffered one of the most astonishing emergencies in aviation history when it lost power in all four engines while cruising over Java. The aircraft becomes a glider, stranded in the darkness and descending with no power. Faced with the possibility of ditching in the water, the crew desperately fight to relight the engines and determine what caused this sudden shutdown. The pilots finally succeed in reigniting the engines, but limited visibility means they are unable to see the runway as they approach Jakarta. After a miraculous landing, all passengers and crew evacuate safely. The investigation reveals that BA009 had unknowingly flown into a cloud of volcanic ash, causing the engines to fail. This episode explores the innovations in detection technology that followed this flight.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: In 1985, an Air India flight vanishes off the coast of Ireland. The rescue mission discovers that the crew had no warning before the jet was ripped apart. Investigators are alerted to a bag checked in without the passenger boarding. Another explosion on the same day at Tokyos Airport is soon linked to this incident. The bomb builder is traced and sent to jail but the person who checked the bag onto the plane has never been caught.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: In 1996, on departure of a Birgenair Flight, the pilot ignores vital information given by a junior crew member before smashing into the ocean. The data recorder reveals the confusing sound of multiple alarms. The plane was giving conflicting information as tubes that measured airspeed had been blocked by insect nests. But disaster could have been averted if the crew had heeded warning signs even before the plane lifted off.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 29, 1972. Eastern Airlines Flight 401 is coming in for a landing in Miami. On the crews instrument panel, one of the three green lights confirming the planes landing gear is down and locked remains unlit. Captain Robert Loft decides to have the auto pilot fly the plane in a holding pattern while he and his crew work to fix the problem. Flying at 2,000 feet all four men in the cockpit focus their attention on the troublesome bulb. None of them notice that the plane is slowly descending to the ground, until its too late. The brand new L-1011 slams into the remote swampland of the Florida Everglades. Miraculously 77 people survive the initial crash. Investigators determine that the plane was mechanically sound, and that its auto pilot was working. So why had the state of the art jetliner fallen from the sky? The clues would lead investigators to a very troubling cause.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archaeologists investigate one of the greatest female pharaohs in history - Hatshepsut. A team digging around her iconic temple find clues about her powerful reign. A rare discovery inside one of Hatshepsut's ancient quarries sparks an investigation which leads to the magnificent temple of Karnak.. And one archaeologist discovers dramatic evidence about the lives of women in ancient Egypt whilst excavating mummy parts from inside an ancient tomb.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archaeologists find extraordinary new evidence about how the ancient Egyptians prepared for the afterlife. We investigate the most elaborate tomb in the valley of the kings, built for the great pharaoh Seti I, the tomb reveals the sacred text needed to secure life after death. A vast necropolis gives up its secrets as a team discovers a sealed tomb untouched for 4,000 years. Whilst analysis of a gruesome cache of mummified remains reveals the disturbing lengths grave robbers went to in search of treasures and gold.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Ever since life emerged, microbes, plants and animals have all sculpted the planets surface and atmosphere in the strangest of ways; fish poop creates islands; dead animals create mountains; plants help create continents. From rocks to rivers, life has crafted everything that makes our planet so special. But this power of change brings with it profound dangers. Life doesnt just create. It can also destroy.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Earth protects itself from the sun. The David and Goliath story of Earths relationship with its greatest threat, our seemingly benign Sun. The Sun is the big violent boss of the Solar System throwing out devastating particles and deadly radiation. Without several shields, one generated by our unique planetary core, another by our atmosphere, and a third by our interconnected weather systems, life on Earth would never have survived.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Delta Flight 191 departs Fort Lauderdale for Dallas-Fort Worth on Aug. 2, 1985. As the aircraft prepared to land, the crew flew into a rapidly intensifying storm, where an unforeseen downburst turned their routine landing into a catastrophe. The crew struggled for control of the plane, but the sudden impact of the downburst made a safe landing impossible. Striking a highway, Delta 191 crashes short of the runway, killing 137 people. In this episode, survivors give chilling firsthand accounts of the final moments onboard. This episode reveals how the disaster led to meteorological breakthroughs in understanding microbursts and improvements in weather reporting at airports.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: In 1982, British Airways Flight 9 suffered one of the most astonishing emergencies in aviation history when it lost power in all four engines while cruising over Java. The aircraft becomes a glider, stranded in the darkness and descending with no power. Faced with the possibility of ditching in the water, the crew desperately fight to relight the engines and determine what caused this sudden shutdown. The pilots finally succeed in reigniting the engines, but limited visibility means they are unable to see the runway as they approach Jakarta. After a miraculous landing, all passengers and crew evacuate safely. The investigation reveals that BA009 had unknowingly flown into a cloud of volcanic ash, causing the engines to fail. This episode explores the innovations in detection technology that followed this flight.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In March 2011, as Japan reels from the most powerful earthquake in its history, a 14 metre-high tsunami surges over the Fukushima Dai-ichi nuclear power plant, knocking out its power supply and essential cooling systems. With the plant blacked out, engineers face nuclear meltdown. The reactors begin to overheat leading to two huge explosions that tear the plant apart and dispersing radiation. As Japan faces the worst nuclear emergency since Chernobyl, an international nuclear expert will investigate exactly what happed at Fukushima and see what, if anything, could have been done to prevent it.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: The Royal Navy's battle with Bismarck is a pivotal point in the Second World War. If Bismarck had succeeded in attacking the British convoy system, then Britain would probably have been forced to surrender, leaving no bridgehead for an Anglo-American liberation of Europe. In losing Bismarck, the Germans lost their opportunity to defeat Britain and turn the tide of war. Naval historian Andrew Lambert has studied this famous sea battle and sheds light on the reasons for Bismarck's fate. He believes the sinking follows a catalogue of errors on both sides, and ultimately he finds fault with the core German war strategy.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: In 1996, on departure of a Birgenair Flight, the pilot ignores vital information given by a junior crew member before smashing into the ocean. The data recorder reveals the confusing sound of multiple alarms. The plane was giving conflicting information as tubes that measured airspeed had been blocked by insect nests. But disaster could have been averted if the crew had heeded warning signs even before the plane lifted off.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 29, 1972. Eastern Airlines Flight 401 is coming in for a landing in Miami. On the crews instrument panel, one of the three green lights confirming the planes landing gear is down and locked remains unlit. Captain Robert Loft decides to have the auto pilot fly the plane in a holding pattern while he and his crew work to fix the problem. Flying at 2,000 feet all four men in the cockpit focus their attention on the troublesome bulb. None of them notice that the plane is slowly descending to the ground, until its too late. The brand new L-1011 slams into the remote swampland of the Florida Everglades. Miraculously 77 people survive the initial crash. Investigators determine that the plane was mechanically sound, and that its auto pilot was working. So why had the state of the art jetliner fallen from the sky? The clues would lead investigators to a very troubling cause.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: In 1985, an Air India flight vanishes off the coast of Ireland. The rescue mission discovers that the crew had no warning before the jet was ripped apart. Investigators are alerted to a bag checked in without the passenger boarding. Another explosion on the same day at Tokyos Airport is soon linked to this incident. The bomb builder is traced and sent to jail but the person who checked the bag onto the plane has never been caught.

programme.title: Dutch Caribbean Coastguards
programme.desc: We went on a mission with the Coast Guard of Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and Sint Maarten. Every day they carry out impressive operations, from rescuing tourists in distress to intercepting drug shipments at sea and receiving undocumented immigrants. This important and also dangerous work is done by a team of committed professionals, who guarantee safety in the Caribbean Sea with the help of ships and helicopters. They are supported by the Royal Netherlands Navy.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Timothy "Curly" Leech and Amanda Makar set out to catch halibut with some borrowed equipment. Gary Muehlberger decides to test his mettle (and age) and return to some old hunting grounds to catch a "Hooter" and see if he's still "got it." Resident inventor and all-around DIY'er, Sam Carlson, tries to cobble together a vertical access wind turbine out of junk and scrap metal from an old shipyard. And Hans Porter sets out to test the town's water supply's pH levels only to discover a dead-standing tree threatening the town's pipeline.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TAM Airlines Flight #3054 Airbus A320 July 17th, 2007 - TAM Airlines Flight #3054 is on its final approach to Sao Paulo's notorious Congonhas Airport. Runway 35-L at Congonhas is one of the most treacherous in the world. It's built on a hilltop, surrounded by tall buildings. The crew of Flight #3054 gets a report that the runway is wet and slippery. Captain Henrique Stephanini brings his Airbus A-320 down at the foot of the 1,945 meter long runway, activates the one working thrust reverser and applies the brakes, but his plane doesn't slow down. It hurtles down the runway at top speed, crosses a highway and slams into a building and adjacent gas station. No one on the plane survives. 12 people on the ground are also killed. This is the worst aviation disaster in South American history. Investigators are under enormous pressure to figure out what went wrong on one of Brazil's busiest runways, before it claims any more lives.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 McDonnell Douglas DC-9-82 (MD-82) August 16th, 2005 - Hours behind schedule, West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 finally takes off from Panama City en route to Martinique. The aircraft flies toward weather so severe that the pilots must divert to avoid it. In addition to the turbulence, the pilots have another problem; their engines are not providing enough thrust. To solve this issue the pilots drop down to a lower altitude, but before they can reach it a Stall Warning fills the cockpit. The plane is flying too slowly to remain airborne. Before the pilots can figure out what has caused the problem, the aircraft drops from the sky and crashes on a remote Venezuelan farm. By far the worst aviation disaster in the country's history, a small team of Venezuelan investigators must now determine what brought down one of the safest airplanes in the world.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Amid civil war in 14th century Mongol-controlled China, scholar and strategist Liu Bowen lends his talents to a dynasty on the rise. But his name is also remembered for a more mysterious talent: fortune-telling with what some say is frightening precision. A series of cryptic prophecies earns him the moniker of China's "Nostradamus." In Ancient Rome, Julius Caesar receives a warning that his life is in danger. The prophecy, uttered by an Etruscan soothsayer, is divined through the strange art of haruspicy. Caesar ignores the omen at his own peril. Amongst the hills of the Scottish Lowlands, the influential Erskine family becomes haunted by a mysterious prophecy, presaging and inflicting countless moments of tragedy and heartbreak.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Harriet Tubman saw her visions as divine messages from God, giving her the strength not only to liberate herself from the bondage of slavery but also to lead hundreds of other enslaved people to freedom by way of the Underground Railroad. In 2001, a blood-red rain falls over Kerala, inciting fears, superstitions and predictions of an imminent apocalypse. But Kerala is not the first city to experience this macabre downpour. And in ancient Greece, the oracle of Apollo at Didyma prophesied that Alexander the Great would invade and conquer the hulking Persian Empire, changing the course of history fore

programme.title: Witches: Truth Behind the Trials
programme.desc: What is a witch? Why did people hunt them? And how did societies tear themselves apart trying to root out such supposed evil? This special episode tells the origin story of the first major witch hunts and trials in Europe during the 16th century. Beginning with Trier in Germany, a terrifying and brutal event engulfs everyone, from lowly peasants to the richest members of society. Shortly after these events, King James VI of Scotland, convinced that dark forces were conspiring against him, embarked on a quest to eliminate all witches from his country.

programme.title: Narco State: Aftermath
programme.desc: In 2009, Ciudad Juárez, Mexico, was called murder capital. Phoenix, USA, was experiencing a rise in kidnappings. More than ten years later, we return to these cities to explore how the smuggling of guns, drugs, money and people connect the U.S. and Mexico in ways that go beyond their shared border.

programme.title: Super Scam Me
programme.desc: Romance scammers stole more than $1 billion from American victims in 2025, and award-winning journalist Mariana van Zeller wants to know how they do it. She is going undercover to become the target of a romance scam. Only by intentionally falling prey to these criminal operators can she fully expose the tactics, technologies and psychology that have made these scams not just common but inescapable. Ultimately, she wants to meet her scammer face-to-face in a journey that will become very real as she uncovers his real name and identity and tracks him to his home in West Africa.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Radio silence between pilots and air traffic controllers can mean many different things, but only the physical evidence can reveal the true story. Three shocking cases send investigators hunting for answers. A Greek airliner goes rogue and crashes outside Athens. A China Airlines 747 disappears from radar and the culprit is discovered on the ocean floor. And, when controllers lose contact with a private jet, fighter planes scramble to intervene.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Twenty minutes after taking off from Taipei, Taiwan a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar. A massive rescue mission is launched, ut all 225 passengers and crew are dead. After ruling out both a bomb and a gas tank explosion, investigators are stumped. They examine hundreds of pieces of wreckage until they discover a single piece of the hull that solves the riddle. Tragically, the crash of Flight 611 began with a problem that began twenty-two years earlier.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 21, 1988. Shortly after taking off from London's Heathrow Airport, Pan Am Flight 103 suddenly explodes in the skies above Lockerbie, Scotland. As the wreckage rains down on the small town below, homes are vaporized and fires break out across the countryside. All 259 people on board are killed. Eleven more in the tiny town also die. The wreckage is scattered over 2,000 square kilometers, and when investigators find proof the aircraft was the victim of a bomb, the area becomes the largest crime scene in the world. Who brought down Flight 103?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Copa Airlines Flight 201 Boeing 737-200 June 6th, 1992 Copa Airlines Flight 201 takes off from Panama City for the one-hour flight to Cali, Colombia. But with a major storm on the horizon, the pilots revise their flight path to avoid the heavy weather. After 12 minutes in the air, the captain radios controllers to tell them they've reached their cruising altitude of 25,000 feet. But moments later, the plane disappears from radar over one of the remotest jungles on earth.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: A specialist team unearth a long-lost tomb in the shadow of the pyramids, as archaeologists hunt for remains and explore hidden tombs in the Valley of the Kings. Why did the great pharaohs of Egypt abandon the pyramids of Giza and choose a secret cemetery in the Valley of the Kings for their burial ground? In the shadow of the pyramids, an extraordinary discovery is made in a rare tomb that's 4500 years old. The team descend 100 metres underground to investigate the first tomb ever built in the valley; while a team from the University of Basel take up the hunt for clues to identify human remains found in looted tombs.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: As part of a joint effort during Super Bowl LIV, dubbed "Operation Team Player," CBP and HSI seize more than 176,000 counterfeit items, and make multiple arrests related to human trafficking and drug smuggling. HSI Atlanta conducts a controlled delivery of a hollowed-out truck battery filled with 5 kilos of heroin. And HSI New York tracks a suspected drug courier, a.k.a. "Busy Bee", who is found to have pellets of cocaine concealed on his person.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Atlanta discovers a suitcase left in the airport by its owner, which contains cocaine concealed in coffee bags. Suspecting a trend, officers begin blitzing flights from the source country and make a second arrest. CBP Miami investigates a series of wildlife trafficking crimes, including an elderly man suspected of smuggling birds to the US in his pants; and a shipment of more than 1400 turtle shell fragments that were forcibly removed from an endangered species. HSI New York arrests a suspected cocaine smuggler who works at JFK and uncovers information that takes-down an entire drug-trafficking ring.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Miami intercept a boat suspected of smuggling narcotics. After a destructive search, they find over 500 kilos of cocaine concealed in the cabin. Meanwhile, in Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents launch an operation on a major highway they suspect is being used by cartels to smuggle drugs, money and people. Off the coast of Florida, agents patrol a route popular with smugglers bringing in contraband from the Bahamas.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Fort Lauderdale are on the hunt for a large shipment of drugs leaving the U.S. With the help of the U.S Coast Guard, they successfully intercept a boat found to be carrying 10 pounds of marijuana. In Gulfport, Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents police the I-10, a notorious smuggling route. Meanwhile, agents patrol the waters for smugglers bringing in illicit goods under the cover of darkness.

programme.title: The Mob's Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: The St. Valentine's Day massacre is the stuff of American legend, and the tale is familiar to nearly everyone. But the story of that bloody day in Chicago has never been told, or seen, like this before. Cutting-edge graphics and frenetic recreations accompany Johnny Fratto, son of onetime Al Capone-associate Louis "Lew" Fratto, back to Chicago, where he uncovers massacre myths and learns more about the life his father and uncles led when they roamed those lawless streets in the 1920s. Johnny gets guidance and opinions from a team of renowned Chicago gangster experts, and bridges the gap between the stories he heard as a little boy and the reality he lived growing up in a mob family. Johnny's take about what happened on Feb. 14, 1929 will surprise you.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat: cocaine smuggling. Police arrest a woman carrying a load of small purses packed cocaine, but she claims she's innocent. When the agents bring in her boyfriend, she erupts in anger. Agents uncover 3 kilos of cocaine disguised as bleaching powder. A woman hides cocaine in her undergarments, but she may be carrying more elsewhere.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: During a regional commuter hop in New Zealand, the pilots of Eagle Airways Flight 2300 struggle to lower their landing gear. They circle the airport to troubleshoot the issue. Low on fuel, they have no choice but to eventually attempt a wheels-up landing. With emergency crews standing by, their twin-engine turboprop gently touches down, slides along the centre of the runway, and comes to a stop—remarkably with no injuries and minimal damage to the aircraft. With a potential disaster narrowly averted, investigators look into what could have caused the landing gear to fail. They soon track a hydraulic leak to a minor part with a major flaw. When they later test the entire fleet of Beechcraft turboprops, they uncover a systemic issue that's endangering passengers worldwide.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. Crossbills have hooked beaks to pluck seeds from spruce cones. As for the rare capercaillie, they digest pine needles by eating stones that grind the needles up in their digestive system. Despite the challenging but seasonal weather conditions, winter is mating season for the Carpathian's most elusive inhabitant and rarest animal: the lynx. Almost extinct in the rest of Europe, the vast wilderness of the Carpathians helps the species survive and thrive.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Set in Botswana's vast and untamed wilderness, "Big Little Giants" follows Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss. Guided by parents, siblings and instinct, these young animals must quickly adapt or fall behind. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.

programme.title: Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale
programme.desc: Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale examined an extraordinary incident that occurred at the Farallon Islands, 27 miles off San Francisco, in October 1997. Two killer whales attacked and drowned a great white shark and ripped out its liver. The incident left biologists mystified. Since then there have been more attacks internationally. What is happening between the two apex predators of the oceans? There are still so many questions left to answer.

programme.title: Song of the Rainforest
programme.desc: China's Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park is a breathtaking biodiversity hotspot where flora and fauna compete and coexist in a delicate dance of survival. This unique location — an island with soaring 1800-meter peaks — has created an environment where plants and animals have evolved in relative isolation from the mainland to live together. The rare Hainan black-crested gibbon, one of the rarest mammals on Earth, sustains the forest by dispersing seeds far and wide in its poop. Weaver ants wage war in the canopy, building homes and finding scorpions to snack on. Pointed-scale pit vipers lurk in the underbrush while shrews and other rodents scramble to find fruit and other morsels that have dropped from the canopy.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērniem ir garlaicīgi, jo ārā līst lietus. Bet vecāki zina, ka vajag tikai nedaudz iztēles, lai varētu izklaidēties aŗī lietū. Bērniem iztēle ir lieliska, varbūt pat pārāk... // Barbagudrais radīja dekoderi, kurš spēj iztulkot dzīvnieku skaņas, bet dzīvnieki fermā un pagalmā neko interesantu nesaka. Barbazū lūdz iztulkot okeāna iemītnieku valodu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vecākus pārsteidz aizvien vairāku reklāmas izkārtņu parādīšanās gar viņu ceļu. Gaisma no reklāmām ir tik spoža, ka naktī vairs nevar saskatīt zvaigznes un visur ir tik daudz stabu! Pietiks! Ģimenei jārīkojas! // Barbalala vēlas kļūt par kovbojmeiteni un Barbazū ir apņēmies viņai palīdzēt. Lai to panāktu, viņai jāiemācās aprūpēt govis un bulli. Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pastāsta pārējiem, cik vareni bija Da Vinči izgudrojumi un nu katrs grib izgudrot ko savu. Ģēniju ir maz, bet ir jautri izgudrot. // Bērniem jāizvēlas - doties baseinā vai izbraukt ar riteņiem. Uzreiz izveidojas divas frontes un tikai Barbazū spēj nosvērt izvēles svarus.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi mēģina uzbūvēt lielu riteņu veikalu līdz Riteņu Festivālam... varbūt Ātrmeistars viņus apsteigs! Kad Motore atsakās iet vannā pirms ģimenes fotografēšanās, Rablam un suņiem jāatrod risinājums.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad vējaina diena traucē būvēt saldējuma veikalu, Rabls, Miksa un Čārdžers ķeras pie darba. Rātsnamā kaut kas mistiski čīkst. Mērs Greitveja lūdz Rablam un Čārdžeram to atrast un salabot pirms viņas runas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Salda un garda diena Blū beķerejā, jo Blū un Džošs cep bibinku, Filipīnās iecienītu kūku. Spēlēsim "Blū pavedieni", lai noskaidrotu, kam Blū vēlas cept, un palīdzētu Banānu cepējai lasīt banānus viņas Pērtiķu mafiniem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Ir Draudzības diena! Kad Ātrmeistara dāvana Makrupuča kungam noiet greizi, viņam jālūdz Rabla komandas palīdzība. Rabla komanda palīdz Lūkasam uzbūvēt lieliskāko Zinātnes izstādes vulkānu. Vai Vingsija stāsies izvirduma ceļā?

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Doras ģimene taisa pinjatu par godu māmiņas dzimšanas dienai, taču tā aizlido! Vai viņi to atradīs, pirms pārnāks māmiņa? Garnadzis nočiepj neredzamības segu un sāk čiept visu pēc kārtas. Dorai viņš jāaptur!

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: "Blū pavedienos tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū un viņas kopējs Džošs acing skatītājus piedalīties mīklu minēšanas piedzīvojumos. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu šo uzdevumu!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Deizija un Krokodilkungs atrod mazu ķirzaku, kas grib līdzināties Krokodilkungam. Vinstons grib būt pārgājiena līderis, bet viņa augsto tehnoloģiju ierīces dēļ visi apmaldās mežā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabravo noķer mistisku maskētu vandāli, kurš cenšas bēgt pēc mājas apzīmēšanas. Pie lietas ķeras detektīvs un doktors. // Barbabravo mīļākā mašīna pazūd no viesistabas. To meklējot Barbabravo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais zem dīvāna atrod dīvainu caurumu. Ja nu mašīna aizkrita līdz zemes centram?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Nē! Nē! Tas nav beidzies! Barbabravo nav mazs, viņš ir liels puika! No šis dienas viņš tā arī dzīvos - nekādu snaudu, uzkodu un spēlēšanās ar brāļiem un māsām. // Barbabērni pirmoreiz dodas uz lielveikalu. Tik daudz preču, lieliska vieta! Bet kāpēc viss satīts plastmasas plēvēs?

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija cenšas panākt, ka Omīte paliek, lai pavadītu vairāk laika kopā. Kad Terija un Tomijs tiek ieslēgti Dārza kupolā, viņiem jāmet malā domstarpības, lai tiktu laukā. Tims palīdz Tijai izbraukt pa jauno raķeštrasi.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas atgriezt pazudušu rāciju tās īpašniekam. Tims un Tomijs dodas kempingā, bet nespēj vienoties, ar ko sākt. Kad Tims atrod bērnības rotaļlietu Blobertu, tas atmodina viņā monstru.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Tija būvē laika mašīnu, lai nebūtu jāatklāj tētim patiesība. Tims dodas uz Dinostāra treniņu akadēmiju, bet ir neizpratnē par sava varoņa metodēm. Tēvocis Tibērijs apciemo Reksus, un Timam jāparāda, ka viņš māk uzvesties.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars sabotē Celtnieklīcības dienu, suņiem jāglābj svētki Celtnieklīcī. Miksa sapņo veikt mēness pārvērtības. Rabls un suņi piepilda viņas sapni ar jaunu raķeškuģa karuseli!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad stirnai Podziņai jāšķērso Celtnieklīča lidostas skrejceļš, Rabls un komanda zina, kas jābūvē. Rabls un komanda uzbūvē milzu skrituļdēli tantes Celtnes un Rivera šovam. Taču, kad tas zaudē kontroli, suņiem jādzenas pakaļ!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora, Zābaciņš, Giljermo un Isabela rotaļājas ārā, taču sākas lietus. Dora dvīņiem pastāsta, ka tādā laikā var laimēties ieraudzīt varavīksni. Varavīksne tiešām parādās, tomēr tai trūkst vairāku krāsu: zilās, sarkanās un dzeltenās! Dora dodas uz Isas dārzu, lai aizņemtos krāsas no košajām puķēm. Uzveikusi Garnadzi, Dora aiznes krāsas Varavīksnei, kura iepriecina dvīņus ar savu košo spožumu. // Zābaciņš ļoti lepojas ar savu krāsaino gumiju bumbu un vēlas to izmēģināt beisbola spēlē. Taču bumba aizlido tālu projām! Karte pastāsta, ka tā nonākusi Kaimiņu mežā, kur dzīvo Simtkāje Sintija. Zābaciņam ir bail uzrunāt daudzkājaino kaimiņieni, tomēr Dora viņu iedrošina. Galu galā Sintija labprāt atdod bumbu... un pat iesaistās draugu spēlē!

programme.title: Dora

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad auto vadītājai Kamilai vajag vietu, kur paēst, kucēniem un Karlam rodas eleganta ideja. Bet vai tā nav pārāk eleganta?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Sveicināti "Blū bistro", ļoti smalkā restorānā! Spēlējot "Blū pavedienus", noskaidrosim, ko Blū vēlas ēst, palīdzēsim Džošam pieņemt mūsu draugu pasūtījumus, kā arī dosimies uz Zemnieka Āža fermu pēc svaigiem dārzeņiem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims dara visu, lai tiktu pie jaunās Dinozvaigznes figūriņas. Ir Astro-joku diena, bet Tims nezina, kad apstāties. Timam un tētim jānoķer traucējošs kurmis.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīcī apmetas migrējošu pīļu bars. Rabla komandai jāpalīdz pīlēm uzsākt ceļu uz dienvidiem. Motore nevēlas doties pie dakteres Divas uz veterināro klīniku... tāpēc ķepaiņi uzbūvē īpašu, tikai viņai paredzētu telpu.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

No matter how much they compete and mess with each other, at the end of the day, they will always bond over their shared love of one thing: wacky nonsense.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Female Gaze
programme.desc: Today, we meet Claire Picheyre, a 32-year-old self-taught photographer living in the Ariège region of southern France. Introduced to photography by her father at an early age, Claire first turned to the medium as a way of preserving memories and resisting oblivion. Over time, she developed a unique form of visual diary, using photography to capture the fleeting moments that shape a life. Her work gradually evolved into a deeply personal exploration through self-portraiture. By placing herself in front of the camera, Claire examines her body, its transformations, its vulnerabilities, and its strength. She photographs herself throughout every stage of her life, during moments of joy as well as periods of hardship. Each image becomes an intimate dialogue between photographer and subject—a confrontation that ultimately leads to self-acceptance. Through this body of work, Claire seeks to encourage women to reconnect with their bodies and reclaim them from objectification, while preserving a subtle sense of sensuality and erotic ambiguity. Photographers are rarely seen in front of the lens. For Claire, self-portraiture is a way to reclaim her own image, bear witness to the passing of time, and leave behind a visual trace of her existence.

Šodien, pārkāpis astoņdesmit gadu slieksni, viņš joprojām saglabājis zinātkāri, dzīvesprieku un vēlmi būt aktīvam. Kas palīdz nezaudēt interesi par dzīvi, kā saglabāt jauneklīgu garu un kāpēc nekad nav par vēlu jauniem piedzīvojumiem? Par to raidījumu cikla "Dzīves ceļojums" noslēdzošajā stāstā atklās Vilnis Līdaka. #SIF_MAF2026

programme.desc: Oktobrī notika pirmais Ventspils iedzīvotāju forums "Ventspils, kā mums te iet?" Tajā pulcējās cilvēki, kuri vēlējās izteikt savu viedokli vai atrast domubiedrus. programme.title: Zaļo domu viktorīna Re, kā!
programme.desc: Zaļo domu viktorīnas "Re, kā!" pirmajā epizodē savā starpā sacentīsies divas spilgtas komandas - "Čehova teātris" un "Nacionālais teātris". Dalībniekiem būs jāatbild uz dažādiem jautājumiem par vidi, ilgtspēju un ikdienas izvēlēm, vienlaikus demonstrējot erudīciju, reakcijas ātrumu un humora izjūtu. Vai teātra cilvēkiem izdosies pārsteigt ar savām zināšanām par zaļo domāšanu?

programme.title: Manas jaunās mājas Latgale
programme.desc: Guntars Skutels ir priesteris, kurš ilgus gadus dzīvojis Itālijā, bet tagad kalpo Viļakā. Viņš apvieno tradicionālo garīgumu ar mūsdienīgu skatījumu uz ticību un sabiedrību, saglabājot ciešu saikni ar vietējo kopienu. Guntars atklāj arī savu lielo mīlestību pret Itāliju — tās kultūru, ēdienus un dzīvesveidu — kas joprojām viņu vilina atpakaļ. Tajā pašā laikā viņa izvēle palikt Latgalē rāda dziļu saikni ar dzimto reģionu un apņēmību kalpot savā kopienā. Video atklāj viņa ikdienu, darbam veltīto aizrautību un spēju iedvesmot cilvēkus dažādās paaudzes, apvienojot garīgumu ar atvērtu, dzīvespriecīgu skatījumu.

programme.title: Kā pieci pirksti
programme.desc: Šoreiz raidījumā "Kā pieci pirksti" stāstīsim par aprites ekonomikas attīstību Latvijā, tās saikni ar ekodizainu, tehnoloģijām un inovācijām. Iepazīsim uzņēmumu ilgtspējīgo praksi, atkritumu apjoma mazināšanas risinājumus un labos piemērus, kā ikviens var veicināt ilgtspējīgāku ikdienu.

programme.title: Spried ar Delfi
programme.desc: Katru darba dienu kopā ar dažādu nozaru speciālistiem, kā arī "Delfi" un citu mediju žurnālistiem aicinām skatītājus spriest par kādu aktuālu tematu - politiķu lēmumiem un to sekām, amatpersonu rīcību un tās motīviem, pārmaiņām sabiedrībā un tās virzītām iniciatīvām, pasaulē notiekošo un tā ietekmi uz Latviju, sasniegumiem un zaudējumiem sportā, kultūras personībām un procesiem.

programme.title: Mācīties no pagātnes: Latvijas muzeju krājumu nelikumīgā aprite 2.pasaules karā un tā atskaņas
programme.desc: Starptautiskās muzeju padomes Latvijas Nacionālā komiteja (ICOM Latvija) piedāvā dokumentālo īsfilmu ciklu, kas tapis projektā "Mācīties no pagātnes: Latvijas muzeju krājumu nelikumīgā aprite Otrajā pasaules karā un tā atskaņas (1940-1990)". Piecās sērijās pētnieki šķetina Latvijas muzeju un to kolekciju likteņus Otrā pasaules kara, okupāciju un pēckara politisko pārmaiņu laikā. Kas notika ar muzeju priekšmetiem, kuri tika izvesti, pārvietoti, sadalīti starp dažādām institūcijām vai pazuda bez pēdām? Sekojot liecībām arhīvu dokumentos, inventāra grāmatās, fotogrāfijās un muzeja krājuma priekšmetos, katra sērija atklāj vienu līdz šim maz zināmu Latvijas kultūras mantojuma stāstu. Dokumentālo īsfilmu cikls aicina ne tikai atskatīties pagātnē, bet arī domāt par muzeju atbildību, kultūras vērtību aizsardzību un zaudētā mantojuma nozīmi mūsdienās. Projektu īsteno Starptautiskās Muzeju padomes Latvijas Nacionālā komiteja (ICOM Latvija) kā viens no partneriem Eiropas Savienības finansētajā projektā PRISM (Prevention, Research, Investigation and Security in Museums), pētot muzeju kolekciju vēsturisko pārvietošanu un nelikumīgo apriti Latvijā. Projektu finansē Eiropas Savienība. Par šeit paustajām atziņām un viedokļiem atbild vienīgi autors(-i); tie ne vienmēr atbilst Eiropas Savienības oficiālajai nostājai. Eiropas Savienība un finansējuma piešķīrējinstitūcija nav atbildīgas par šo saturu.

programme.title: Svētku kūka
programme.desc: Šodienas raidījums ir veltīts īpašiem mirkļiem - tiem, ko atceramies visu mūžu. Un kas gan var būt simboliskāks par kāzu torti - kūku, kas iemieso mīlestību, jaunu sākumu un kopā būšanu. Kāzu torte nav tikai deserts - tā ir svētku centrālais akcents, kas apvieno skaistumu, garšu un emocijas. Šodien parādīsim, kā dekorēt gardu svētku torti, kas būs cienīga jebkurām kāzām. Ilze Kupča Kūciņa pārsteigs ikvienu mājas kūku mīļotāju un pierādīs, ka tas ir iespējams ikvienam! Kopā ar skaisto kāzu torti dosimies ciemos uz īstām Latgaļu kāzām. Tā ir komēdijizrāde "Kāzas Latgalē" - 24 stundu trakākais piedzīvojums jaunā pāra mūžā. Šo grandiozo kāzu vadītājs ir aktieris Imants Strads. Skaidrosim, kādas tad ir īstas Latgaļu kāzas? Un uzzināsim vai aktierim bieži nākas pašam vadīt kāzas? Uzzināsim arī kādu kāzu atgadījumu.

programme.title: Pieslēgums
programme.desc: Vēja enerģija var dot Latvijai lielāku enerģētisko neatkarību un jaunas ekonomiskās iespējas. Mēģināsim saprast, kā sadalās ieguvumi un iespējamie zaudējumi. Noskaidrosim, kā tiek izraudzītas vietas vēja parkiem, kurš pieņem lēmumus par to būvniecību un kādas iespējas vietējiem iedzīvotājiem ir šos lēmumus ietekmēt. Raidījumā pētīsim, cik nozīmīga Latvijas energoapgādē jau šobrīd ir vēja enerģija un cik daudz tās mums vajadzētu nākotnē. Runāsim ar vēja parku attīstītājiem, pašvaldību pārstāvjiem, vides ekspertiem un cilvēkiem, kuru ikdienu šie projekti ir mainījuši. Viesosimies pie lauksaimnieka, kurš piekritis vēja turbīnas būvniecībai uz savas zemes, un uzklausīsim arī tos, kuri pret vēja parku ienākšanu savā apkārtnē iebilst.

programme.desc: "Augustes iedvesmas dārzs" ir neparasta vieta Saulkrastu novada Sējas pagastā, kur aizrautīgi saimnieko Laura Dance. Vispirms jau dārzs ir iedvesmas avots pašai Laurai. Aizejot no darba, kas vairs nesniedza piepildījumu, un meklējot nodarbošanos, kas iepriecinātu, viņa saprata, ka vēlētos strādāt dārzā. Pirmie gadi dārzā aizvadīti smagi strādājot, mācoties, eksperimentējot, vienlaikus priecājoties par paveikto un kaļot arvien jaunus plānus, lai Latvijā būtu par vienu skaistu vietu vairāk.

programme.title: Tiksimies stacijā!
programme.desc: 19.⁠ ⁠gadsimta beigās, atšķirībā no Rīgas un Liepājas, uz Ventspils ostu dzelzceļa vēl nebija. Ar investīcijām tādu būvēt nāca privātā Ribinskas dzelzceļa sabiedrība. Līniju Ventspils-Maskava būvēja pa posmiem. Pirmos iecirkņus, arī no Tukuma līdz Ventspilij, atklāja 1901. gadā, bet starp Jelgavu un Krustpili - 1904 . Latvijas teritorijā dzelzceļa garums ir 456 km. Šī satiksme kalpoja lauksaimniecības produktu pārvadāšanai, piemēram, iecienīts bija Sibīrijas sviests, arī naftas produktiem un, protams, neiztikt bez pasažieriem. Diemžēl 2000. gadā pasažieru satiksmi starp Jelgavu un Krustpili pārtrauca. Kas noticis ar staciju ēkām? Šai reizē iegriezīsimies Garozā, no kuras savulaik bija izbūvēts arī šaursliežu atzars. Vērsim Iecavas stacijas ēkas durvis un uzzināsim Misas stāstus. #SIF_MAF2026

programme.title: Ceļā uz pasaules malu: Eiropas robeža
programme.desc: Trīs draugi, motocikli un ceļš, kas ved pretī nezināmajam. Didzis Lūkins, Edgars Solovjovs un Jānis Mežulis dodas aizraujošā piedzīvojumā uz Spāniju, lai iepazītu ne tikai valsts ainavas, kultūru un cilvēkus, bet arī paši sevi. Dokumentālā filma atklāj brīvības sajūtu, negaidītus notikumus un īstu draudzību ceļā, kur katrs kilometrs nes jaunus izaicinājumus, emocijas un stāstus. Tas ir ceļojums uz diviem riteņiem, kur svarīgākais nav tikai galamērķis, bet viss, kas piedzīvots pa ceļam.

programme.title: Baigais numurs
programme.desc: Jaunākajā "Baigais Numurs" epizodē numeroloģe Ilze Buna-Lediņa caur numeroloģiju pēta Latvijā atpazīstamu personību ceļu, raksturu un panākumu kodu. Kā Andris Daugaviņš bez aktiera pieredzes nonāca līdz Lielajam Kristapam? Pats sevi viņš sauc par "izklaidētāju", bet skatītāji viņu pazīst no tādiem projektiem kā Kriminālās ekselences fonds, Nelūgtie viesi un citi. Šajā sarunā mēģināsim saprast - kas bija tas, kas viņu aizveda līdz straujiem panākumiem pilnībā nomainot savu profesionālo jomu pēc 40 gadu vecuma?

programme.title: Līdaku ielenktie
programme.desc: ReTV ar prieku piedāvā skatītājiem pirmo Latvijā tapušo dokumentālo piedzīvojumu TV seriālu makšķerniekiem! Tas būs saistošs gan mūsu lielajai copmaņu komūnai, gan arī dabas piedzīvojumu cienītājiem. Seriālā atspoguļotas sešu pieredzējušu piedzīvojumu meklētāju-makšķernieku gaitas, pirmo reizi dodoties ar mašīnām un jumta teltīm Norvēģijas virzienā, meklējot tās mazskartajos ūdeņos līdakas, foreles un citas zivis. Pirms došanās ceļā pavadītas daudz stundas, rūpīgi pētot kartes, ūdeņus, makšķernieku forumus Latvijā un Novēģijā, kā arī ievācot informāciju no tiem retajiem Latvijas makšķerniekiem, kas pabijuši Norvēģijas iekšzemes ūdeņos, meklējot līdakas un citas zivis. Salikts plāns, kura viena no stabilākajām un nemainīgajām lietām ir… pārmaiņas, pielāgošanās apstākļiem, nezināmajam un neparedzamajam. 10 dienās džeki saskārās gan ar copi, gan necopi, gan izmisumu, gan plānu maiņu, gan viegliem, gan grūtiem lēmumiem un visu citu, kas piestāv šādam ceļojumam.

programme.title: Ceļot bez robežām
programme.desc: Šovasar izbaudi dažādas pasaules valstis un kultūras kopā ar "Ceļot bez robežām"! Sezonas laikā būs iespēja iepazīt krāšņo Indiju un tās senās tradīcijas, tempļus un kontrastus, redzēt vienu no septiņiem pasaules brīnumiem, kā arī atklāt Šrilankas dabas bagātības un vietējo iedzīvotāju dzīvesveidu. Tāpat ciemosimies sākumskoliņā, ko pēc cunami atjaunoja par latviešu saziedotajiem līdzekļiem. Bet Amerikas Savienotās Valstis pārsteigs ar savu plašumu, pasakaini skaistiem kanjoniem, kā arī tiks piedzīvotas kārtīgas lietus gāzes tuksnesīgajā pilsētā Lasvegasā. Ceļojums turpināsies Eiropā, viesojoties Evijas salā, kur skatītāji iepazīs tās dabas burvību, atklājot vairākas skaistas pludmales. Bet sezonas noslēgumā apmeklēsim "Tropical Islands" parku Vācijā - vienu no lielākajiem iekštelpu tropu kūrortiem Eiropā, kur iespējams izbaudīt vasaru jebkurā gadalaikā.

programme.title: Zaļā gaisma
programme.desc: Auto, drošība uz ceļa, jaunāko noteikumu un likumu skaidrojumi. Raidījumā pastāstīsim par jaunākajām aktualitātēm, kas jāzina un jāņem vērā katram autovadītājam.

programme.title: Gaidām ciemos!
programme.desc: "Gaidām ciemos!" ir par dažādu valstu kultūru, vēsturi un tradīcijām. Raidījuma vadītājs Zurabs Dvaļi ceļo un aicina skatītājus kopā ar viņu pastaigāties pa skaistām vietām, novērtēt apskates vietas, apbrīnot dabu un satikt interesantus cilvēkus. Skatītāji vispirms uzzinās interesantus vēstures faktus par dažādu valstu slavenākajiem vai aizmirstākajiem reģioniem, bet pēc tam izzinās kulinārijas tradīcijas, kopā ar raidījuma viesiem gatavojot vairākus ēdienus.

programme.title: Veselības kompass
programme.desc: Raidījums stāstīs par dažādiem ar veselību saistītiem jautājumiem, sniegs padomus un vedīs tevi ceļā uz veselīgāku dzīvesveidu, labāku pašsajūtu un priecīgāku ikdienu! Katru nedēļu uz sarunu aicināsim dažādus jomas ekspertus un kopā gan sportosim, gan apspriedīsim dažādas ar veselību saistītas tēmas, gan arī izmēģināsim daudz kā jauna un mūsu veselībai noderīga!

programme.title: Kāpēc
programme.desc: Žurnāliste Alina Lastovska katru nedēļu stundu garā raidījumā piedāvā karstas un aktuālas diskusijas, kā arī analītiskas intervijas, kas palīdz atrast atbildes uz tik dažādajiem "kāpēc", izgaismojot neērtas patiesības, atbildīgo personu patiesās domas un rīcības motīvus, atklājot cēloņsakarības un to, kādas korekcijas nepieciešamas "kursā", lai veicinātu Latvijas izaugsmi.
